<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="0A0u8kvohfA64R-HLiJ-"> <mxGraphModel dx="1117" dy="614" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1100" pageHeight="850" background="light-dark(#ffffff, #121212)" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
top to bottom direction
skinparam backgroundColor #FFFFFF
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam linetype polyline
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam defaultTextAlignment center

skinparam RectangleBackgroundColor #F8F9FA
skinparam RectangleBorderColor #6C757D
skinparam NodeBackgroundColor #FFFFFF
skinparam NodeBorderColor #333333

title BrewLite - Production Deployment Diagram (Vertical)

actor \"Người dùng\" as User

rectangle \"1. Client & DNS Tier\" {
 node \"Domain Name (DNS)\" as Domain
 node \"Trình duyệt / PWA\" as Browser
 node \"CDN / Edge / Reverse Proxy\" as CDN
}

rectangle \"2. AWS EC2 Production Platform\" as Platform {
 node \"Ubuntu Server\" as Server
 node \"Amazon ECR\n(Container Registry)\" as Registry
 node \"SSH Key Pair\" as KeyPair
 node \"Biến môi trường / Secret\" as Config
}

rectangle \"3. Application Services\" as AppContainer {
 node \"Frontend Next.js\" as Web
 node \"Backend NestJS API\" as API
}

rectangle \"4. Data & Monitoring Tier\" as DataSvc {
 node \"PostgreSQL\" as DB
 node \"Dịch vụ thanh toán mô phỏng\" as Payment
 node \"Health + Logging\" as Logs
}

' Connections
User --> Browser : HTTPS
Browser --> CDN : HTTPS
CDN --> Web : Phục vụ ứng dụng
Domain --> Server : Trỏ tới server
KeyPair --> Server : SSH authentication
Server --> Registry : Build / pull image
Server --> Web : Triển khai frontend
Server --> API : Triển khai backend

Web --> API : HTTPS / REST API
API --> DB : SQL / ORM
API --> Payment : Yêu cầu thanh toán nội bộ
API --> Config : Đọc cấu hình
API --> Logs : Health + log lỗi
Payment --> Logs : Log giao dịch
Web --> Config : Cấu hình runtime công khai
DB --> Logs : Health DB + giám sát
Server --> DB : Lưu trữ bền vững

note right of Platform
Production target platform
Health checks, HTTPS,
container registry and persistent DB
end note

note bottom of Config
Secrets are not committed to source control
end note

@enduml",
